producer_report.summary: Root cause: the reader brief resolved job ids only from the request text. Ids cited by a retry's introspection (earlier cases, cause, prevention) were never resolved to those jobs' recorded deliverables, so readings invented fixtures and thresholds. `referenced_jobs` now takes the retried attempt. It carries request-named jobs first (cap 3), then jobs the introspection cites (new cap `MAX_CITED_JOBS` = 4), deduped against the jobs already carried. Both go through the existing `carry()`, so they are redacted and bounded. The 'Referenced jobs' section now prints each job's recorded acceptance criteria and deliverables and tells the reader to take fixtures, sizes and thresholds from them. The prior-result intro says only the retried job and followed-up jobs must be accounted for. No refusal rule was added (checks.rs untouched, so 0% newly refused), and no prompt file changed. The CHANGELOG records the cause, the three instances and the limit. New tests cover the resolver, the brief rendering, a real-path retry, and a corpus Accept case.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core referenced` to check; the test fails on the base code, which ignores such ids, and passes with the change.

open_issues: README.md line 72 says at most three jobs are carried. Up to four more may now be carried when an introspection cites them. README is not a deliverable here, so I left it; the CHANGELOG states the second cap.
Ids the reader itself introduces in its own reading are not resolved. Closing that needs a refusal check, which is out of scope. Noted in the CHANGELOG and the doc comment as a follow-up.
The topics.rs tests do not compile on the base, because referenced_jobs changed signature. The assertion-level failure on the base is shown by the retry.rs and briefs.rs tests.
mistakes: First draft of the cap test used a job id with seconds 99, which is out of range. Fixed to 000059.
learnings: The producer shell allows only cargo, git, ls, mv, rm and chmod: no grep, tail, sed or cd. `cargo test -q` keeps output short.
Job ids in tests must be valid timestamps (seconds up to 59) or RecordId::parse fails.
The reading::tests module is reachable from reading::topics tests, because topics is a descendant of reading.
